reconnect-ran.description: Reconnect the gNB, then start UE1 and UE2 after NGAP becomes ready.
reconnect-ran.impact: Interrupts radio connectivity for all attached UEs. Stops and starts only the UE1/UE2 services; does not kill other UE processes.
reconnect-ran.verification: Wait for registration, then run ue1-status, ue1-sessions, ue2-status, ue2-sessions and a tunnel probe. NGAP up alone is insufficient.
reconnect-ran.command:
sudo -n systemctl stop ueransim-ue1 ueransim-ue2
sudo -n systemctl restart ueransim-gnb
ready=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 10); do
  state=$(sudo -n timeout 3 /opt/UERANSIM/build/nr-cli UERANSIM-gnb-1-1-1 --exec status 2>&1) || state=''
  if printf '%s' "$state" | grep -q 'is-ngap-up: true'; then ready=1; break; fi
  sleep 2
done
if [ "$ready" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'NGAP not ready; UE1/UE2 remain stopped. Inspect gNB and core logs.' >&2; exit 1; fi
sudo -n systemctl start ueransim-ue1 ueransim-ue2
systemctl is-active ueransim-gnb ueransim-ue1 ueransim-ue2

reset-core-and-ran.description: Restart the fixed 5G core service set, then reconnect the RAN.
reset-core-and-ran.impact: Disrupts 5G registration and sessions. Does not clear fault rules, alter subscribers, restart IMS, or reset application records.
reset-core-and-ran.verification: Run core-status, ue1-status, ue1-sessions, ue2-status, ue2-sessions and tunnel probes. If a step fails, inspect before continuing.

steps.command:
sudo -n systemctl restart open5gs-nrfd open5gs-scpd
sudo -n systemctl restart open5gs-udrd open5gs-udmd open5gs-ausfd open5gs-pcfd open5gs-nssfd
sudo -n systemctl restart open5gs-upfd
sudo -n systemctl restart open5gs-smfd
sudo -n systemctl restart open5gs-amfd
systemctl is-active open5gs-nrfd open5gs-scpd open5gs-udrd open5gs-udmd open5gs-ausfd open5gs-pcfd open5gs-nssfd open5gs-upfd open5gs-smfd open5gs-amfd

sudo -n systemctl stop ueransim-ue1 ueransim-ue2
sudo -n systemctl restart ueransim-gnb
ready=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 10); do
  state=$(sudo -n timeout 3 /opt/UERANSIM/build/nr-cli UERANSIM-gnb-1-1-1 --exec status 2>&1) || state=''
  if printf '%s' "$state" | grep -q 'is-ngap-up: true'; then ready=1; break; fi
  sleep 2
done
if [ "$ready" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'NGAP not ready; UE1/UE2 remain stopped. Inspect gNB and core logs.' >&2; exit 1; fi
sudo -n systemctl start ueransim-ue1 ueransim-ue2
systemctl is-active ueransim-gnb ueransim-ue1 ueransim-ue2

if tmux has-session -t noc-phone1 2>/dev/null; then
    pgrep -af '[l]inphonec.*linphonerc_ue1' >/dev/null || { echo 'STOP: managed session has no phone. Inspect it before restarting.' >&2; exit 1; }

    tmux capture-pane -p -t noc-phone1 -S -20
elif pgrep -af '[l]inphonec.*/home/config/.linphonerc_ue1'; then
    echo 'STOP: This phone is already running outside the managed session. Use the documented phone reset action before retrying.' >&2
    exit 1
else
    tmux new-session -d -s noc-phone1 'sudo -n linphonec -c /home/config/.linphonerc_ue1 -a'
    sleep 3
    tmux capture-pane -p -t noc-phone1 -S -20
fi

week01--phone1-start.impact: Changes the named environment resource or writes files. Read the exact command before running.
week01--phone1-start.verification: Inspect the result and collect fresh evidence as directed by the source lab. Execution success is not service recovery.
week01--phone1-start.prerequisites: Complete the relevant setup in LAB_capstone_week01.md; this catalog does not create its helpers, phone sessions, or configuration.
week01--phone1-start.command:
if tmux has-session -t noc-phone1 2>/dev/null; then
    pgrep -af '[l]inphonec.*linphonerc_ue1' >/dev/null || { echo 'STOP: managed session has no phone. Inspect it before restarting.' >&2; exit 1; }
    echo 'Existing managed session; inspect its output before continuing.'
    tmux capture-pane -p -t noc-phone1 -S -20
elif pgrep -af '[l]inphonec.*/home/config/.linphonerc_ue1'; then
    echo 'STOP: This phone is already running outside the managed session. Use the documented phone reset action before retrying.' >&2
    exit 1
else
    tmux new-session -d -s noc-phone1 'sudo -n linphonec -c /home/config/.linphonerc_ue1 -a'
    sleep 3
    tmux capture-pane -p -t noc-phone1 -S -20
fi

week01--phone1-reset.impact: Changes the named environment resource or writes files. Read the exact command before running.

week01--phone1-reset.prerequisites: Complete the relevant setup in LAB_capstone_week01.md; this catalog does not create its helpers, phone sessions, or configuration.
week01--phone1-reset.command:
# Explicit recovery only: stop this configured classroom phone, not other subscribers.
sudo -n pkill -TERM -f '[l]inphonec -c /home/config/.linphonerc_ue1( |$)'
rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 1 ] || exit "$rc"
sleep 2
if pgrep -af '[l]inphonec.*linphonerc_ue1'; then
    echo 'STOP: phone still running; no new copy was started.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
if tmux has-session -t noc-phone1 2>/dev/null; then
    tmux kill-session -t noc-phone1 || exit 1
fi
echo 'Selected phone stopped. Run the start action, then verify registration.'
